question.text: If $\left(x^2 \log _x 27\right) \cdot \log _9 x=x+4$ then the value of $x$ is

solution.text:
Hint: $\left(x^2 \log _x 27\right) \cdot \log _9 x=x+4$
$\begin{aligned}
& \Rightarrow x^2 \cdot \log _9 27=x+4 \Rightarrow x^2 \cdot \log _{3^2} 3^3=x+4 \Rightarrow \frac{3}{2} x^2=x+4 \\
& \Rightarrow 3 x^2-2 x-8=0 \Rightarrow 3 x^2-6 x+4 x-8=0 \Rightarrow(3 x+4)(x-2)=0 \\
& x \neq-\frac{4}{3} \therefore x=2
\end{aligned}$
